categories.main_business_segments: Ares Management Corporation operates five primary business segments: Credit, Private Equity, Real Estate, Secondary Solutions, and Strategic Initiatives. Each segment manages a range of investment strategies and vehicles, including funds, separately managed accounts, and publicly traded entities. The Credit Group is the largest by assets under management, followed by Real Estate, Private Equity, Secondary Solutions, and Strategic Initiatives, which includes insurance and Asia-Pacific focused activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Ares leverages a disciplined, credit-oriented investment philosophy across its segments, utilizing proprietary research, fundamental credit analysis, and flexible capital deployment. The firm employs rigorous due diligence, financial modeling, and both qualitative and quantitative risk assessments. Its platform integrates cross-segment collaboration, local market expertise, and advanced data analytics to identify, structure, and manage investments globally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ares serves a diverse investor base, including over 1,800 direct institutional relationships such as pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, banks, endowments, and foundations, as well as a significant retail investor base through publicly traded and sub-advised funds. Its end markets span corporate, real estate, infrastructure, and alternative asset sectors, with tailored products for both institutional and retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ares operates in more than 40 offices across over 15 countries, with a strong presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. The firm manages global investment strategies and has local teams in key financial centers, enabling it to source and manage investments worldwide. Its Strategic Initiatives segment further expands its reach in Asia and the insurance sector.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ares functions as a downstream financial services provider, acting as an asset manager and capital allocator. It sits at the end of the financial supply chain, raising and managing capital from investors and deploying it into various asset classes and investment vehicles, including direct lending, private equity, real estate, and secondary markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Ares' strategic priorities include expanding its product offerings, enhancing distribution channels (notably in global wealth management), increasing global presence, and investing in non-investment functions and technology. The firm emphasizes innovation in alternative investments, ESG integration, and strategic acquisitions to drive growth and maintain market leadership. Recent initiatives include expanding into secondaries, insurance solutions, and Asia-Pacific credit.
categories.revenue_model: Ares generates revenue primarily through management fees based on assets under management, incentive fees (including carried interest and performance fees), and returns on its own capital invested in its funds. Management fees are typically recurring and based on committed or invested capital, while incentive fees are performance-based and realized upon achieving specified investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ares competes with global alternative asset managers, private equity firms, hedge funds, traditional asset managers, and financial institutions. Key competitors include Blackstone, Apollo, KKR, Carlyle, and Brookfield, among others. Ares positions itself as a leading, diversified alternative investment manager with a strong track record, comprehensive multi-asset expertise, and a collaborative, integrated platform.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, Ares managed $305.8 billion in assets under management, up from $49 billion a decade earlier, reflecting a 26% five-year and 20% ten-year compound annual growth rate. The firm raised $76.8 billion in new capital in 2021 and deployed $81 billion, demonstrating significant scale and robust growth across all segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ares differentiates itself through its comprehensive multi-asset platform, flexible capital deployment, proprietary research, and consistent risk-adjusted returns across market cycles. Its collaborative culture, global reach, and ability to offer tailored solutions to both institutional and retail investors underpin its value proposition. The firm emphasizes strong client relationships, innovation, and ESG integration as key drivers of stakeholder value.
